blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) has reiterated its commitment to working with the Department of Energy (DOE) to help address the power shortage in the Visayas grid. In a statement released late Tuesday afternoon, October 6, NGCP said it recognized the DOE’s concerns over the recent power alerts […]...
